title: The COVID lab-leak idea is just a conspiracy theory
short_summary: In early 2020 major journals, officials, and platforms treated the laboratory-origin hypothesis for SARS-CoV-2 as a fringe conspiracy theory. Private contemporaneous records show leading scientists took laboratory scenarios seriously.
label: False
evidence_for: Very little primary scientific evidence in Feb-Mar 2020 forced the conclusion that lab origin was fringe.
evidence_against: WIV conducted bat SARS-related CoV research including genetic manipulation, with U.S. funding via EcoHealth.
Early private scientific discussion took lab scenarios seriously; Fauci diary confirms this.

title: NIH has not ever and does not now fund gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology
short_summary: Fauci and NIH stated NIH never funded GOF at WIV. Contested: narrow regulatory definition vs ordinary scientific usage; chimeric work under EcoHealth subawards is documented.
label: Contested
evidence_for: NIH applied a specific regulatory definition tied to the 2014-2017 pause and later P3CO framework.
evidence_against: Documented chimeric coronavirus construction under EcoHealth to WIV subawards.
Ordinary scientific usage of GOF covers enhancement of human-cell infectivity.

title: The Lancet Letter (19 February 2020)
short_summary: Organized by Peter Daszak; 27 signatories. Condemned non-natural-origin claims as conspiracy theories. Published after private calls that took lab scenarios seriously.
label: True

title: The Proximal Origin of SARS-CoV-2 (Nature Medicine, 17 March 2020)
short_summary: Andersen et al. concluded SARS-CoV-2 is not a laboratory construct. Drafting overlapped private Jan-Feb calls; FOIA/Slack show non-trivial lab-origin probabilities during drafting.
label: True

title: Peter Daszak
short_summary: President of EcoHealth Alliance. PI on NIH bat-CoV grant with WIV subawards. Organized Feb 2020 Lancet letter. Debarred by HHS 2024-2025.
label: True

title: Jeremy Farrar
short_summary: Wellcome Trust Director 2013-2023; WHO Chief Scientist from 2023. Central convenor of early Feb 2020 origins calls preceding Proximal Origin and the Lancet letter.
label: True

title: Kristian G. Andersen
short_summary: Lead author of Proximal Origin. Central in 31 Jan / 1 Feb 2020 private calls; private communications assigned non-trivial lab-origin probability before the public paper ruled it out.
label: True

title: EcoHealth Alliance
short_summary: U.S. nonprofit; NIH grants with WIV subawards for bat-CoV research. Central funding intermediary. Suspended then debarred by HHS 2024-2025.
label: True

title: Wellcome Trust
short_summary: Independent global biomedical foundation (London). Farrar was Director 2013-2023 during the early origins window.
label: True

title: Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV)
short_summary: Premier Chinese SARS-related CoV research center; BSL-4. Central node via bat-CoV work, EcoHealth/NIH subawards, and outbreak epicenter location.
label: True

title: USAMRIID / Fort Detrick

label: True

title: Galveston National Laboratory

title: NEIDL — Boston University

title: NIAID / NIH Intramural High-Containment Cluster
